rules.statement: Section 68 of the Evidence Ordinance does not apply to a criminal case where the prosecution has made the attesting witnesses also accused in the case and is impugning the deed as a forgery committed due to abetment by the witnesses.
rules.supporting_quote: "In such a case, the elements of the charges which have to be established by the prosecution may be established in any of the ways permitted by law."

meta.parties: The Solicitor General v. Ava Umma
